name: Orca IDE
description: Create and drive Orca IDE worktrees and terminals via the `orca` CLI.

command.label: Orca Command
command.help: Path or command name for the orca CLI. Defaults to "orca". On Linux, outside an Orca-managed terminal, bare "orca" resolves to the GNOME Orca screen reader — set this to "orca-ide" instead. Overridden at runtime by the ORCA_CLI_COMMAND environment variable when set.

environment.label: Remote Environment
environment.help: Optional saved remote Orca runtime id (added via `orca environment add`), passed as --environment.

pairingCode.label: Pairing Code
pairingCode.help: Optional one-off pairing code for remote Orca auth, passed as --pairing-code.

timeoutSeconds.label: Command Timeout Seconds
timeoutSeconds.help: Timeout for orca CLI invocations. Defaults to 30 seconds.

waitTimeoutSeconds.label: Terminal Wait Timeout Seconds
waitTimeoutSeconds.help: Ceiling for orca_terminal's wait action. Defaults to 300 seconds.
